title: Fair Value Measurement
summary: Provides a single framework for measuring fair value, including a three-level hierarchy and valuation techniques, substantially converged with IFRS 13.

bannerNotice.title: Substantially converged with IAS/IFRS
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 113 reproduces IFRS 13's single fair value framework and three-level hierarchy almost exactly. Its most notable Indian interaction is with the Registered Valuers framework under the Companies Act, 2013/IBBI.
